quotes.text:
- type: product-details
  # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
  url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/releasenotes?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel={release-type}
  conditions:
      release-types: [release, beta]
- type: product-details
  # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
  url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/releasenotes?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel=esr
  conditions:
      release-types: [esr128, esr140, esr153]

- type: show-url
  # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
  url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/whatsnew?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel=release&oldversion=%OLD_VERSION%
  conditions:
      blob-types: [wnp]
      release-types: []
      products: [thunderbird]
      update-channel: release
      versions: ["<{version.major_number}.0"]
- type: show-url
  # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
  url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/whatsnew?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel=beta&oldversion=%OLD_VERSION%
  conditions:
      blob-types: [wnp]
      release-types: [beta]
      products: [thunderbird]
      update-channel: beta
      versions: ["<{version.major_number}.0"]

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The release show-url entry has an empty release-types list, while product-details still covers release and beta and other show-url entries cover ESR and beta. Preserve the distinction when changing update configuration: the assigned fix disables the release-channel Whats New action, not every release-note URL or every channel. The taskgraph or Balrog output was not generated to validate matching here. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep release Whats New conditions separate from product release notes
